• Install, configure and maintain clients, peripherals, applications and operating systems

• Perform updates, patches and technical maintenance to ensure stability, performance and security

• Supporting and advising users on technical issues in everyday work

• Creating and maintaining instructions, documentation and known solutions

• Collaboration with internal IT departments in the event of disruptions, changes and operational concerns

• Experience in ICT support, IT support or workplace environment
